name: attractions
description: Places to visit around Kalpetta, Wayanad - distances are kilometres from the stay

data_quality.note: Entry fees, opening hours and weekly holidays are not published: the source data holds template defaults (fee 0 for 0 of 73 places,  for 41). Descriptions and coordinates shared between unrelated places, and distances shorter than the straight-line distance, are withheld (null). Confirm details before relying on them.

excluded_after_fact_check.name: Kungichira Museum & Chira
excluded_after_fact_check.reason: Planned museum near Periya; coordinates were copied from the Tea Museum

excluded_after_fact_check.name: Manjappara
excluded_after_fact_check.reason: Could not be located in Wayanad (possibly a different Manjappara in Idukki)

excluded_after_fact_check.name: Kalpetta Food Spots
excluded_after_fact_check.reason: Navigation entry for the food page, not a place

attractions.name: Mailadippara
attractions.description: A rocky hill on the eastern edge of Kalpetta, near the Civil Station and the bypass road, climbed on foot for views over the town

attractions.name: Ananthanatha Swamy Jain
attractions.description: Jain temple of Tirthankara Ananthanatha Swami on Puliyarmala hillock, about 5 km from Kalpetta

attractions.name: Gandhi Museum
attractions.description: A small Gandhi memorial museum and library at Puliyarmala, about 4 km from Kalpetta, beside the Ananthanatha Swamy Jain temple

attractions.name: Chundale Tea Estate (Harrisons Malayalam)
attractions.description: Harrisons Malayalam tea estate at Chundale, about 7 km south of Kalpetta on the Meppadi road, with its own CTC tea factory

attractions.name: Ziplines
attractions.description: Zip lines in Wayanad are offered at the Karapuzha Dam adventure park and at the 900 Kandi Skypark, each with its own ticket

attractions.name: Uravu
attractions.description: A non-profit bamboo centre at Thrikkaipetta, about 10 km from Kalpetta, with a bamboo nursery, craft workshop and shop

official_fee.value: No entry fee

attractions.name: Honey Museum
attractions.description: Private museum on honey and beekeeping at Old Vythiri, run by Beecraft, with displays on bees and honey collection and a honey shop

official_timing.value: 09:30-18:30, Monday to Friday (weekend hours not published)

official_fee.value: INR 30 (guided tour)

attractions.name: Tea Museum, Achoor (Harrisons Malayalam)
attractions.description: Tea museum in the Achoor Estate of Harrisons Malayalam at Achoor, near Pozhuthana, on the history of tea growing in Wayanad

attractions.name: Trikaipatta temple
attractions.description: Shiva temple at Thrikkaipatta near Meppadi, Wayanad, with shrines to Ganesha, Ayyappa and the serpent deities

attractions.name: Pookode Lake
attractions.description: Natural freshwater lake at 770 m near Vythiri, about 12 km from Kalpetta, shaped roughly like the map of India, with boating

official_fee.value: Adult INR 40, child INR 30; boats 2-seater 300, 4-seater 450, 7-seat 700

attractions.name: Meenangadi Church
attractions.description: Syriac Orthodox Marian pilgrim church at Meenangadi, known for the relic of St. Mary's girdle (Soonoro)

attractions.name: Our Lady of Lourdes Shrine, Pallikunnu
attractions.description: Latin Catholic church of Our Lady of Lourdes at Pallikunnu, founded in 1908 by the French priest Fr. Jefreno

attractions.name: Chain Tree
attractions.description: Ficus tree with a chain around it beside the highway at Lakkidi, tied to the folk legend of the tribal guide Karinthandan

official_fee.value: No entry fee

attractions.name: Harrisons Malayalam Tea Estate, Arrapetta
attractions.description: Harrisons Malayalam tea estate at Arrapetta, near Meppadi, with its own factory making orthodox tea

attractions.name: Kolagapara
attractions.description: Hill with a large monolithic rock about 5.5 km from Meenangadi, climbed on a steep 2 km trail through forest patches and tea gardens

official_fee.value: 0 (no entry fee)

attractions.name: En ooru
attractions.description: Kerala's first tribal heritage village, at Pookode near Vythiri, with traditional huts, performances and tribal craft stalls

official_fee.value: Adult INR 50; camera INR 150; shuttle jeep INR 40 (up and down); tickets for age above 3; offline booking only

attractions.name: Karapuzha Dam
attractions.description: Earth dam 625 m long and 28 m high on the Karapuzha river, built for irrigation, with gardens and an adventure park

official_fee.value: Adult INR 30, child (under 15) INR 10; zipline INR 390, VR zone INR 170-199

attractions.name: Lakkidi Ghats View Point
attractions.description: Roadside viewpoint at the top of the Thamarassery ghat pass, about 700 m up and 5 km from Vythiri, overlooking the hairpin bends

attractions.name: Chembra Peak
attractions.description: Wayanad's highest peak, about 2,100 m, near Meppadi; the guided trail passes a heart-shaped lake, Hridaya Thadakam

official_timing.value: 07:00-15:00 entry; trekking needs forest-department permission; the second half of the trek is restricted because of wildlife

official_fee.value: Entry INR 50, foreigner INR 80; guided trek INR 4,000 for up to 5 people plus INR 800 per additional person

attractions.name: Rippon Tea estate
attractions.description: Tea plantations around Ripon junction in Muppainad, near Meppadi, on the hill road south of Kalpetta

attractions.name: Kanthanpara Falls
attractions.description: Waterfall of about 100 ft on the Vaduvanchal road, 8 km from Meppadi, beside the Meppadi forest range

official_fee.value: Adult INR 40, child INR 30, photo shoot INR 1,000

attractions.name: Kurumbalakotta
attractions.description: A hill in Kottathara panchayat near Venniyode, about 991 m high, climbed at dawn for views over the Wayanad plateau

attractions.name: Cheengeri Hill
attractions.description: Open rocky hill near Ambalavayal run by DTPC as a trekking spot, with views over the Karapuzha river and reservoir

attractions.name: Koottamundu Glass Temple Wayanad
attractions.description: Jain temple of Parswanatha Swami on the slopes of Vellarimala near Koottamunda, known for its mirror-lined inner walls
attractions.review_note: Stated coordinates conflict with the ~20 km road distance in Kerala Tourism

attractions.name: Ambalavayal
attractions.description: Kerala Agricultural University's research station at Ambalavayal, with a nursery open to visitors and the annual Pooppoli flower show

attractions.name: Bamboo Forest Valentine's Park
attractions.description: A small privately run park among bamboo groves in the Nadavayal area of Wayanad, about 21 km from Kalpetta, for a quiet walk in the shade. Opening hours and fees are not confirmed: call before you go

attractions.name: Banasura Sagar Dam
attractions.description: Earth dam and reservoir at the foot of the Banasura Hills, about 21 km from Kalpetta, with boating and islands in the reservoir

official_fee.value: Adult INR 40, child INR 20; speed boat INR 1,000 (5), pontoon INR 2,000, kayak INR 250-450, zipline INR 350

attractions.name: Karlad Lake
attractions.description: Natural freshwater lake at Thariode, 3 km from Banasura Sagar Dam, home to DTPC's Wayanad Adventure Camp with a zipline over the water

attractions.name: Varampatta mosque
attractions.description: Mosque at Varambetta in Padinjarathara panchayat, described by Kerala Tourism as one of Wayanad's oldest, about 300 years old

attractions.name: Neelarchalu
attractions.description: Tribal village between Ambalavayal and Meppadi, surrounded on three sides by the Karapuzha reservoir, with a sunset viewpoint over the water

attractions.name: Soochipara Falls
attractions.description: Three-tier forest waterfall near Meppadi, also called Sentinel Rock, about 23 km from Kalpetta; daily visitor numbers are capped

official_fee.value: Adult INR 150, student INR 50, foreigner INR 300

attractions.name: Meenmutty Falls
attractions.description: Three-tier waterfall about 5 km from Banasura Sagar Dam, with a total drop that DTPC gives as over 800 ft

official_fee.value: Adult INR 100, student INR 50, foreigner INR 200, still camera INR 53, video INR 301

attractions.name: 900 Kandi
attractions.description: An adventure park in the forested 900 Kandi hills near Meppadi, with a glass-floored bridge, zip line, swings and off-road jeep rides
attractions.review_note: Stated coordinates are about 7.5 km from the real location

official_fee.value: Adult INR 250, child INR 100; zip line INR 350; zip cycling INR 250; adventure swing INR 100; rifle INR 50. Glass bridge and jeep ride fares not listed. Offline booking only.

attractions.name: Phantom rock
attractions.description: A skull-shaped granite rock formation near Ambalavayal, named after the comic hero the Phantom and reached by a short trek

attractions.name: Valliyoorkavu temple
attractions.description: Bhagavathy temple near Mananthavady where Durga is worshipped as Vana Durga, Bhadrakali and Jala Durga

attractions.name: Edakkal Caves
attractions.description: Natural rock caves on Ambukuthi hills, 10 km from Sultan Bathery, with ancient engravings of human figures and animals

official_fee.value: Adult INR 50, child INR 30; photo shoot INR 1000

attractions.name: Banasura Sagar Hills
attractions.description: A Western Ghats hill range above Banasura Sagar Dam, climbed on a guided forest-department trek that needs prior permission

official_fee.value: Group of 5: Indian adults INR 4000 (+INR 650 per extra person), students INR 2500 (+INR 350), foreigners INR 7000 (+INR 1250); still camera INR 53, video camera INR 301. Offline booking only. DTPC: "The trek is advisable for people aged 11-plus."

attractions.name: Mananthavady Pazhassi Tomb
attractions.description: Memorial and museum at Mananthavady on the Kabani riverbank, where Pazhassi Raja was cremated in 1805

official_fee.value: Adult INR 30, child INR 20; photo shoot INR 1000 (one travel source gives 20/10)

attractions.name: Pulpally Sitadevi temple
attractions.description: 18th-century temple at Pulpally, one of the few in Kerala dedicated to Seetha Devi, with idols of Lava and Kusa

attractions.name: Bamboo Rafting
attractions.description: Bamboo rafting on the Kabini River at Kuruva Island, a forested river island near Mananthavady managed for visitors by DTPC Wayanad

official_fee.value: Rafting Rs 100 adult, Rs 50 child (20 min); island entry Rs 220 adult, Rs 440 foreigner, Rs 100 student; kayaking Rs 300 for 2 (20 min); paddling Rs 1,250 for 5 (45 min)

attractions.name: Sultan's Bathery Valmiki Ashram
attractions.description: Simple thatched hermitage near Pulpally that local tradition links to Sage Valmiki and to Sita's stay in the forest
attractions.review_note: Located in Pulpally rather than Sultan Bathery

attractions.name: Neelimala view point
attractions.description: A hilltop viewpoint near Vaduvanchal, reached by jeep track and a trek, known for its view of Meenmutty falls

attractions.name: Chetalayam falls
attractions.description: Small seasonal waterfall in forest about 12 km from Sulthan Bathery, reached on foot; it runs low or dry in summer

attractions.name: Keluvaidyar, Kattikulam
attractions.description: Keluvaidyar is a traditional herbal healer of the Kurichya tribal community in Kattikulam, a town in the Mananthavady area of Wayanad. The blog reports that people travel to him from other cities, among others for asthma, diabetes and skin conditions such as psoriasis and eczema. Source: the Kallivalli blog post Tribal medicine and its practitioners (2014). Not medical advice; BWStays has not verified these reports. Address, timings, fees and contact are not published; the map position is the area, not the healer's door

attractions.name: Trishileri temple
attractions.description: Ancient Shiva temple about 8 km north-west of Mananthavady, ritually linked to the Thirunelli temple

attractions.name: Begur Forest Range
attractions.description: A forest range of the North Wayanad Forest Division near Mananthavady and Tholpetty; it is not a separate wildlife sanctuary

attractions.name: Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: Southern part of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary near Sulthan Bathery, visited by Forest Department jeep and bus safaris

official_timing.value: Safari 06:00-10:00 and 15:00-18:00; tickets close when the vehicles for the slot are full (morning 8 buses + 8 jeeps, evening 6 buses + 7 jeeps). Kerala Tourism eco-tourism page gives 07:00-10:00 and 15:00-17:00.

official_fee.value: Bus safari: adult INR 350, child/student INR 175, foreigner INR 700. Jeep (Indian): INR 2,100 (4), 2,410 (5), 2,725 (6); jeep (foreigner): INR 4,200/4,500/4,800. Camera INR 45, video INR 255.

attractions.name: Priyadarshini Hills (Priyadarshini Tea Environs)
attractions.description: Tea estate of a cooperative society for formerly bonded tribal families, about 9 km from Mananthavady, with tea tours, a tea factory and treks

official_fee.value: Adult INR 100, child INR 50

attractions.name: Kuruwa Deep
attractions.description: 950-acre protected river delta of forested islets in the east-flowing Kabani river, reached by raft

official_timing.value: 09:00-15:30 entry (activities until 16:30; 488-visitor cap); seasonal monsoon closure reported

official_fee.value: Adult INR 220, foreigner INR 440, student INR 100 (rafting INR 100/50 extra)

attractions.name: Sita Lav Kush Temple ponkuzhy
attractions.description: Ramayana-linked temple beside the Ponkuzhi river on the Sulthan Bathery-Mysore road, about 4 km from Muthanga

attractions.name: Munneswaran Kunnu
attractions.description: Grassy hilltop near Thalappuzha in Mananthavady taluk, reached by a steep walk from Makkimala, with a small Shiva shrine on top

attractions.name: Pakshipathalam
attractions.description: Boulder caves at about 1,740 m in the Brahmagiri Hills, reached on foot from Thirunelli and known for a large bird colony

attractions.name: Boys Town
attractions.description: A campus about 13 km from Mananthavady where the Wayanad Social Service Society runs a herbal garden, gene park and farm units

attractions.name: Tirunelli
attractions.description: Ancient Maha Vishnu temple at Thirunelli, set in forest beside the Brahmagiri hills, about 32 km from Mananthavady

attractions.name: Vellanvaidyar, Thirunelli
attractions.description: Vellanvaidyar is a traditional herbal healer of the Kurichya tribal community, described as practising at the foot of the Thirunelli temple in northern Wayanad. The blog reports that people travel to him for a range of ailments, among them asthma, diabetes and bone fractures. Source: the Kallivalli blog post Tribal medicine and its practitioners (2014). Not medical advice; BWStays has not verified these reports. Address, timings, fees and contact are not published; the map position is the area, not the healer's door

attractions.name: Papanasini River
attractions.description: Sacred mountain stream from the Brahmagiri hills, about 1 km from Thirunelli temple, where devotees perform rites for ancestors

attractions.name: Brahmagiri
attractions.description: Guided forest trek of about 10 km from the Thirunelli forest camp to the Brahmagiri summit, about 1,608 m, on the Kerala-Karnataka border

official_fee.value: Group of 5: INR 3,500 (guide included), INR 700 per extra person; DTPC also lists INR 700 + INR 600 guide = INR 1,300 per single adult. Foreigners INR 7,000 for 5, INR 1,500 per extra person. Students only above 15.

attractions.name: Tholpetty wild life sanctuary
attractions.description: Northern block of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, east of Mananthavady near Thirunelli, visited on Forest Department jeep safaris

official_fee.value: Jeep safari (Indian): INR 2,100 (4 pax), 2,410 (5), 2,725 (6); foreigners: INR 4,200 / 4,500 / 4,800

attractions.name: Arripara falls
attractions.description: Waterfall on the Iruvanji river near Thiruvambady in Kozhikode district, about 15 km from Thiruvambady town
attractions.review_note: Aripara Falls is in Kozhikode district, not Wayanad

official_fee.value: Adults INR 10, children INR 5; offline booking only

attractions.name: Government & Cooperative Trust Places
attractions.description: Handicraft and spice shops at the entrance of Pookode Lake, near Vythiri, in the DTPC-run lake area

attractions.name: Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary
attractions.description: Conservation garden near Periya in northern Wayanad, founded in 1981, that grows and restores native plants of the Western Ghats
attractions.review_note: North Wayanad; the stated 10 km from Kalpetta is doubtful

attractions.name: Irrupu falls
attractions.description: Waterfall of about 170 ft on the Lakshmana Tirtha river in the Brahmagiri Hills of Kodagu, Karnataka, near the Wayanad border
attractions.review_note: Iruppu Falls is in Kodagu, Karnataka; the Brahmagiri trek needs a Karnataka Forest permit and guide

official_timing.value: Open all year; daily hours not published

attractions.name: Nagarhole wild life sanctuary
attractions.description: Tiger reserve in Karnataka next to Wayanad's Tholpetty sanctuary, with Forest Department safaris from the Kabini, Veeranahosahalli and Nanachi gates
attractions.review_note: Nagarhole is a national park in Karnataka, not a Wayanad sanctuary

attractions.name: Scheduled Tribe Cooperative Society Outlet
attractions.description: Scheduled Tribes cooperative society at Kalloor near Sulthan Bathery that buys forest produce such as wild honey from tribal collectors

attractions.name: The Tribal Spot Near the Forest
attractions.description: Shopping place at Kunnathidavaka, Wayanad, Kerala

attractions.name: Thusharagiri
attractions.description: Three waterfalls near Kodenchery in Kozhikode district, the tallest dropping about 75 m, within a few hundred metres of each other
attractions.review_note: Thusharagiri Falls is in Kozhikode district, not Wayanad

official_fee.value: INR 30 per person; offline booking only

attractions.name: Vanamoolika Herbals
attractions.description: Wayanad farmers' and women's collective, started in 1991 to protect native medicinal plants, that grows and sells organic herbs and spices

attractions.name: Wayanad Heritage Museum
attractions.description: Archaeological and heritage museum at Ambalavayal with tribal artefacts, hero stones and finds from the Neolithic age onwards

official_fee.value: Adult INR 30, child INR 20; multi theatre INR 20; multimedia with show INR 50; photo shoot INR 1,000

attractions.name: Wayanad Heritage Museum Shop
attractions.description: Shopping place at Ambalavayal, Wayanad, Kerala
